audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Singed Levels 3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items on a lane Darius wins 52.31% of the time over 1669 games, and phases[1] read Skill at 4/10.
audit.why: Both layers contradicted the win rate and the entry's own whys, which give Darius levels 1 through 6 outright.
audit.corrected: Darius through Level 6, Skill on both item stages — the same seven rows the mirror entry (audits/top/singed__darius.json) proposes from Singed's side, so the two pages agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] and whys[6] read as clean Darius and clean Singed stages respectively, which no longer matches the corrected item rows.
audit.why: Chart rows and their explanations have to say the same thing.
audit.corrected: Both item whys rewritten as contested stages: Stridebreaker keeps him glued, Rylai's and proxy scaling pull the other way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive (W) grounds. Noxian Guillotine is a leap, so while you are standing in the goo you cannot cast your execute at all. Nothing on either layer says this. spikes[2].text also calls it 'his Ghost + W root slow' — Mega Adhesive slows and grounds; the root only exists when Fling drops you inside it — and contains the typo 'a proot fling'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Mega Adhesive is 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it'; Fling — 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' Losing your ultimate mid-all-in because you are standing in a puddle is the single most punishing thing in this lane.
audit.corrected: Grounding-blocks-Guillotine stated, the Fling-into-adhesive root sequenced correctly, Mega Adhesive at 17s and Fling at 10s at rank 1, and the typo removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no numbers and whys[0] called Fling 'a long cooldown'.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 — it is back before your Apprehend is halfway home at 26s. Calling it long inverts the trade schedule.
audit.corrected: Real numbers for Fling, Mega Adhesive, Insanity Potion and Apprehend.

audit.whatIsWrong: Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, halving the Decimate heal that carries your long trades; nothing says when that lands.
audit.why: Riot's text on Insanity Potion: 'making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.' It is a 100s cooldown, so the anti-heal is a window, not a constant.
audit.corrected: Written into the cooldown row and dosFull[0].

edits.before: Singed's only level-1 tool is Fling on a long cooldown, so your Q poke and Hemorrhage rule the opener.
edits.after: Singed's level-1 tool is Fling, back every 10 seconds, so your Q poke and Hemorrhage rule the opener.

edits.before: First item Stridebreaker glues you to him so his movement speed can't peel the all-in.
edits.after: Contested at first item: Stridebreaker glues you, but Rylai's starts buying him escapes.

edits.before: By two-plus items Singed's Poison Trail, Rylai's slow, and proxy scaling outlast your burst, tilting the lane his way.
edits.after: By two-plus items it is a coinflip: Poison Trail and proxy scaling answer your burst, the pull and execute still answer him.

edits.before: R Noxian Guillotine closes out any Fling misplay — if Singed flips you into his minions you can still ult him out from full-stack Hemorrhage before Poison Trail ticks you down.
edits.after: R Noxian Guillotine closes any Fling misplay — but it is a leap, and Mega Adhesive grounds, so step off the goo before you press it or the execute simply refuses to cast.

edits.before: Stridebreaker or Trinity keeps you glued through his Ghost + W root slow so a proot fling doesn't buy him the escape he needs.
edits.after: Stridebreaker glues you through Ghost and the Mega Adhesive slow, so a Fling that drops you outside the goo buys him no escape.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. Bait it, then pull. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — 10s at rank 1. Bait it, then pull. If it drops you inside Mega Adhesive (17s) you are rooted, and the goo grounds, so Noxian Guillotine will not fire until you are off it. - Insanity Potion: 100s, and it puts Grievous Wounds on his poison, halving your Decimate heal. - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, the longest gap here — never spend it on a proxy walk-back you cannot finish.

edits.before: His flip. Bait it, then pull. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: His flip, 10s at rank 1 — bait it, then pull. Anti-heal before his 100s ultimate.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Landing in Mega Adhesive roots you, and its grounding blanks the Guillotine leap until you step clear.

notes: Mega Adhesive grounds, and Noxian Guillotine is a leap — standing in the goo takes your execute away mid-all-in. Absent from both layers and now stated. spikes[2].text carried the typo 'a proot fling' and mislabelled Mega Adhesive as a root; the root only happens when Fling drops you inside it. Chart matched neither the win rate nor the mirror; corrected to the same seven rows audits/top/singed__darius.json proposes, so the pages agree.
